Me, I am an old man now, 72 years, and this small plot of beans I plant together with some maize like we always do here in Mangochi. Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize — the plant itself makes the soil strong, that is what our fathers taught us. I will put a little manure from the goats around the house, and if my coupon comes I may sprinkle a small handful of fertilizer on the maize lines, but not really for the beans. I cannot afford to buy pesticide or to hire many people; my sons and grandchildren help me when they can, and I work slowly myself.
